Quiet-window closeout and divergence disposition — 2026-08-26

Outcome
- The targeted rewrite published successfully. OLD_TIP=56236267c975e6d59156163678f0dc4e7771737b; rewritten epoch base=19708d1422a27edef2272afa6c7b882f8c188c8e.
- Manifest digest=79687943ae1094051966679c31c36f5d0a0d938fb22b7000c88b63aab3edc165. Independently verified backup bundle SHA-256=37e6a0736ed631a852faae61fcda2d46162797c99d68d67bda770f8baa496963.
- Writer freeze receipts showed the old tip stable at 23:32:36Z before Jira deletion and still stable at 23:38:56Z before publication. AWS/local/remote OID, deployed-epoch refusal, candidate replay, rollback/forward, and exact-lease publication checks passed.
- Jira DELETE returned HTTP 204 for 997143, 997144, 997145, 997255, 997256, and 997293. Survivors 963510, 963511, 963512, 963788, 963789, and 964272 remained present; all non-target comment bytes were identical. The completed 12-record journal was replayed idempotently during this final check: it issued no new DELETE and matched the saved post-cleanup Jira observation exactly.
- Whole-store replay and strict fsck passed during execution. Rollback reproduced OLD_TIP and forward replay reproduced the rewritten tip. The two production-runtime dry runs planned zero comment, label, or link operations with equal canonical plan digests.
- All 1,520 removed path aliases remained absent after staged service restoration. Current origin/tickets=4ceb7b35127a84c54638e909ee4bd8594037a170 is descended from 19708d1422a27edef2272afa6c7b882f8c188c8e, and a fresh current-tree oracle again found 0 of 1,520 aliases.

Evidence receipts
- /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-comment-echo-window.YxHlh1/pre-jira-delete-freeze.json
- pre-publication-freeze.json, jira-cleanup-verification.json, whole-store-replay.json, rollback-forward-receipt.json, rollback-replay.json, local-epoch-probe.json, dry-run-differential-receipt.json, dry-run-lifecycle-validation.json, and footprint-measurements.json in the same private off-repository directory.

Measured footprint
- Tracked logical bytes: -254,356,888; tracked allocated bytes: -255,553,536; tracked files: -760.
- This did not solve pack-history growth: the rehearsal candidate reachable pack was +354,184,985 bytes and whole-clone allocation was +98,484,224 bytes versus the old source. The checked-out payload reclaim is real, but history-retention remediation remains separate future work.

Service restoration
- Reconcile Bridge run 33029396329 succeeded; heartbeat 33029925099 succeeded; dependency advisory 33030080673 succeeded; compaction dry run 33030247891 succeeded. All GitHub workflows are active.
- The AWS MCP is healthy behind the intentional blue/green upstream on port 8093 with in_flight=0. The port difference is expected blue/green state, not a bug.
- The review bot was recreated and is healthy. Its first backfill completed; Gerrit retains the durable review votes. The AWS autodeploy timer remains intentionally disabled because a secret refresh would remove the temporary overlap-drain setting.

Preserved AWS divergence assessment
- Forensic clone: /var/gerrit/site/retired-ticket-clones/reviewbot-tickets-divergent-376bc29e. It remains untouched and retained: HEAD=376bc29eadd42f9bb4335f4e365bf53119bb41d3; tracking ref=9ffd0f8ed06d458e54192cbc05d4ff391f49a58e; 399 commits ahead, comprising 312 merges and 87 non-merges. The diff has exactly 87 added paths and no modified or deleted paths; one untracked DONE_ENRICH remains preserved.
- Event inventory: 65 ENQUEUE_ENRICH, 1 CLAIM_ENRICH, 5 CREATE, 7 REVIEW_RESULT, and 9 LINK events, totaling 220,198 bytes, plus the untracked DONE_ENRICH. There are no COMMENT, EDIT, STATUS, DELETE, or other user-ticket mutations and no hidden historical event paths.
- All five CREATE events are code_review artifacts. src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py documents that emission occurs after the Gerrit vote and is best-effort because the vote is already durable; code_review is excluded from Jira reconciliation by src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/config.py. The nine links are only relates_to edges from those artifacts to existing implementation tickets.
- Gerrit independently retains the exact review outcomes represented by the artifacts: change 2248 patch 1 has BLOCK then PASS and patch 2 PASS, now merged; change 2239 has the divergent patch 4 BLOCK twice and patch 5 BLOCK and remains active on patch 7; change 2247 patch 1 PASS is merged; change 2244 patch 2 BLOCK remains active on patch 3. Therefore losing the best-effort ticket sidecars does not lose the merge gate decision.
- Of the 65 divergent enrichment enqueues, 50 already have an authoritative pending enqueue. The other 15 are present-fresh with done=true and pending=false; restoring them would only cause redundant enrichment. The single divergent claim lease had expired before commit and authoritative state already has a pending request. The untracked DONE_ENRICH predates the authoritative latest enqueue, so the reducer ignores it.

Disposition: restore no divergent events. They are semantically redundant operational/enrichment records or best-effort code-review sidecars whose authoritative outcomes are durable in Gerrit. Restoring them would add stale or duplicate work without recovering user state. The divergence is safe to discard when the operator chooses, but the forensic clone has not been deleted, fetched, reset, or garbage-collected so the evidence remains available.

Future work deliberately remains open: apparent-sighted-cockatoo covers longer-horizon history policy and polite-antivirus-bedbug covers enrichment-growth remediation; neither acceptance scope was completed by this operation.

Final superseding divergence disposition — 2026-08-26

The earlier closeout conclusion to restore no divergent events is superseded only for the bounded audit subset. Task nice-ashamed-crustacean completed and is closed. Exactly 21 authenticated code-review audit events were transplanted through one canonical batch write: five CREATE, seven REVIEW_RESULT, and nine LINK events; manifest SHA-256 eee3b2c6e1fb7a9c1df690ce4aa711ebfcc945c33b71223718a70ae82934dcf5. Publication commit 3239a5d7cb8c56f9b1ca940ecd4f8ab9da350f2a is reachable from current origin/tickets.

The operational/enrichment disposition is unchanged: all 65 ENQUEUE_ENRICH, the one CLAIM_ENRICH, and the untracked stale DONE_ENRICH remain excluded. Zero of 1,520 reclaimed comment aliases were restored. All six deleted Jira duplicate IDs remain absent and all six survivor IDs remain present. Both forensic AWS clones remain preserved for analysis.

Service is fully restored: the local store lock is released, Reconcile Bridge is active, the AWS review bot is running and returns HTTP 200, post-start webhooks were accepted, and surviving paused local processes were resumed. No further quiet window is held.

This completes the quiet-window operation and the approved selective audit-event remediation. Longer-horizon history policy and enrichment-growth work remain open in their existing future tickets.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Six rollout-created comments remain duplicated in live Jira and reachable `tickets` history after
the reconciler fixes stopped the echo loop. Closed prerequisite `irongray-unlucky-discus` proved
the causal pairs and rehearsed it. The operator authorized the quiet window; direct
writer evidence, not an elapsed wait, controls entry.

The older bridge-cache HEAD-tree oracle is invalid for intentional removal; see `docs/comment-echo-reclaim-runbook.md:21`, `:68`, `:269`. Preparation measured about 254 MB logical removal versus 26 MB clone savings, so size is observed, not gated.

## Approach

Update from `origin/main` with enrichment drain off. Stop writers, sync AWS MCP to live `origin/tickets`, then freeze stable OID/ref reads; any movement restarts artifacts.

Regenerate evidence in a new `0700` off-repo directory and full clone. Use
`prepare_reclaim_backup.prepare` (`infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py:292`),
`comment_echo_reclaim_manifest.build_manifest` (`infra/scripts/comment_echo_reclaim_manifest.py:746`),
and `reclaim_comment_echo_history.rewrite` (`infra/scripts/reclaim_comment_echo_history.py:743`).
Replay both tips, rehearse rollback/forward, and probe stale deployed writers before mutation.

With the reconciler disabled, use only `cleanup_comment_echo_jira.run`'s digest-bound journal
(`infra/scripts/cleanup_comment_echo_jira.py:478`). Delete `997143,997144,997145,997255,997256,997293`;
preserve `963510,963511,963512,963788,963789,964272`. Prove convergence twice, publish
`refs/heads/tickets` once with the exact frozen lease, replace every persistent clone, then restore
writers one runtime at a time.

Causal manifest identity, the exact lease, and the epoch guard address deletion ambiguity, ref movement, and stale union while retaining proven backup, journal, and reclone controls; no recurring gate is added.

## Scope

`file_impact_scope=none` is deliberate: repository files are read-only. Only the six Jira
duplicates, manifest-listed echo material, final epoch, `origin/tickets`, and persistent clones
change; sensitive artifacts remain off-repo.

Survivors, non-target state, bridge bindings, retained bytes, and other refs are excluded.

**DATA LOSS RISK:** After Jira DELETE but before publication, Jira lacks six IDs while old tickets still records them. This state is quarantined, auditable, and never serviceable: the manifest, journal, inventories, bundle, OLD_TIP, and NEW_TIP bind the mismatch. On failure preserve evidence/candidate, keep writers stopped, re-read both systems, then use a separately reviewed forward correction; Git rollback cannot restore Jira IDs.

## Testing

- Happy path: run `git fetch origin` then `git merge --ff-only origin/main`; require writer/ref receipts plus equal AWS/local/remote tickets OIDs.
- Failure path: disposable stores prove drift refuses before mutation, crash/resume issues no
  second DELETE, a moved ref rejects `--force-with-lease`, and deployed old-epoch runtimes refuse
  both union paths.
- Rollback rehearsal: use exact leases to restore `OLD_TIP` then reapply `NEW_TIP` in a disposable remote; require ref/replay/fsck parity.
- Live checks: run the Jira helper GET-only, inspect its six-action digest, then run
  `python infra/scripts/cleanup_comment_echo_jira.py --repo "$SOURCE" --manifest "$MANIFEST" --artifact-dir "$JIRA_ARTIFACTS" --execute --confirm-manifest-digest "$MANIFEST_DIGEST"`.
  Require fixed survivors plus unchanged non-targets. Two production-runtime reads must plan zero
  comment/label/link actions, perform no write, keep bytes unchanged, and reproduce the pinned plan.
- Publication: run only
  `git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/tickets:"$OLD_TIP" origin "$NEW_TIP":refs/heads/tickets`.
  A fresh clone must pass replay/fsck and reject old ancestry before writers restart.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [non-codebase] Every known ticket writer is quiescent; checked from live workflow, queue, process, container, review-bot, service, reconciler-ref evidence. Record `writer-freeze-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=prod-writers; principal=operator; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — live runtime receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The stopped AWS MCP clone equals the final live tickets OID; checked by three `git rev-parse`/`git ls-remote` reads. Record `aws-sync-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=AWS-MCP; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — live OID receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The fresh source yields one independently restored bundle; checked by `git bundle verify "$BUNDLE"`. Record `backup-restore-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=isolated-clone; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — bundle receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The manifest names exactly six authorized deletions plus six fixed survivors; checked by the builder plus `shasum -a 256 "$MANIFEST"`. Record `manifest-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=frozen-Git-Jira; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — manifest receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Candidate replay has only the manifest delta plus epoch; checked by the whole-store oracle plus `git fsck --strict`. Record `candidate-parity-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=isolated-candidate; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — parity receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Every deployed old-epoch runtime refuses both stale-union paths; checked by refusal exits with unchanged refs. Record `epoch-refusal-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=deployed-images; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=simulation — refusal receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Disposable rollback reproduces `OLD_TIP`; checked by the exact-lease rehearsal plus `git fsck --strict`. Record `rollback-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=disposable-remote; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=simulation — rollback receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] A post-DELETE/pre-publication failure remains quarantined with its exact mismatch recorded; checked by `jira-after.json`, journal, `OLD_TIP`, plus `NEW_TIP`. Record `partial-failure-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=quarantined-systems; principal=operator; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — mismatch receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Live Jira retains exactly `963510,963511,963512,963788,963789,964272`; checked by `jira-after.json`. Record `jira-cleanup-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=Jira-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — journal receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Two post-delete candidate passes plan zero comment/label/link operations; checked by equal canonical plan digests. Record `convergence-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=prod-reconciler; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — dry-run receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] `origin/tickets` equals `NEW_TIP` after one exact lease; checked by the push receipt plus fresh clone. Record `publication-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=authoritative-remote; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — publication receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Every persistent writer starts at the new epoch; checked by clone OID receipts. Record `clone-replacement-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=prod-writers; principal=operator; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — replacement receipt.
- [ ] [non-codebase] Staged writer restoration creates no replacement target body; checked after each first pass by Jira inventory plus tickets replay. Record `non-resurrection-<UTC>`.
  provenance: environment=prod-stores; principal=operator; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — restoration receipt.
